name: ast-grep
description: Structural code search and previewed, staged rewrites through the ast-grep CLI.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the ast-grep tools on for new sessions. /ast-grep on|off overrides it for a session.

alwaysLoaded.title: Always loaded
alwaysLoaded.description: Put the four tools' schemas in every request instead of behind ToolSearch.

binary.title: ast-grep binary
binary.description: The ast-grep executable: a name on PATH or an absolute path.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Time limit for each ast-grep process, 5 to 300.
